label: chat_sample_fixture
description: Hand-written, fixed fixtures for POST /api/chat — one labeled example per response status. All values here (seed rows, mocked LLM responses, and expected responses) are fabricated for testing only — nothing here is live OpenRouter output or real saved-hotel data.

answer.question: What's the cheapest stay at Sample Hotel for Oct 10-12?
answer.mocked_sql_response:
WITH nights AS (
SELECT sh.hotel_id, sh.name, sh.address, n.stay_date, n.nightly_rate_cents, n.rooms_available
FROM saved_hotels sh
JOIN demo_hotel_nights n ON n.hotel_id = sh.hotel_id
WHERE sh.hotel_id = 'sample-hotel-1' AND n.stay_date IN ('2026-10-10', '2026-10-11') AND n.rooms_available > 0
),
totals AS (
SELECT hotel_id, name, address, COUNT(*) AS nights_found, SUM(nightly_rate_cents) AS total_cost_cents
FROM nights GROUP BY hotel_id, name, address HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
)
SELECT nights.hotel_id, nights.name, nights.address, nights.stay_date, nights.nightly_rate_cents, nights.rooms_available, totals.nights_found, totals.total_cost_cents
FROM nights JOIN totals ON totals.hotel_id = nights.hotel_id
ORDER BY totals.total_cost_cents ASC, nights.hotel_id, nights.stay_date LIMIT 50
answer.mocked_answer_response:
Hotel: Sample Hotel
Location: 1 Sample St, Sampletown, CA
Stay: Oct 10-11, 2026 (checkout Oct 12 excluded)
Nightly rate: $100
Total cost: $200 for 2 nights
Availability: 20 rooms
Reason: the only saved hotel matching your dates, available both nights
